explanation: At GO it is almost always 10 (8-9 after about trial 85), and at D2 it is 9 (8 when a1 was chosen, falling to 4-7 after about trial 85); at D1 it is about 8-9 if the previous trial was unrewarded and about 4-6 if it was rewarded. Late in the episode (after about trial 85) the D1 values fall: unrewarded gives 5-7 and rewarded gives 0-3, often exactly 0.
